newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire says thousands of Ugandan troops invading.
newsitem.headline: Zaire says thousands of Ugandan troops invading.

text.p: Zaire said on Wednesday several thousand Ugandan troops had invaded its territory, with some units heading towards the jungle city of Kisingani and mineral-producing Shaba Province.

A statement by Zaire's military high command said about 2,000 Ugandan troops who left Fizi, some 100 km (60 miles) south of the rebel-held eastern Zaire town of Uvira, were heading in direction of Kalemie in Shaba Province.

"We have also observed the presence on the Uganda-Zaire border of 2,000 men transported in vehicles and armed with machineguns. These men crossed into Zaire after being supplied with petrol by the Ugandan state," the statement said.
"Their objective is to reach Isiro," it said, referring to the Upper Zaire town about 350 km (220 miles) west of the Ugandan border.
"A second group of Ugandan soldiers is trying to cross Lake Mobutu."
